bullets.text: Heavy overnight rain of 36 cm caused widespread flooding in Chennai due to uncleared mouths, and the office should monitor drainage clearance.
The National Disaster Response Force is on standby with boats and rescue gear in Velachery, and the office should oversee swift deployment.
In Thiruverkadu, residents faced severe hardship due to a power outage lasting over eight hours, and the office should coordinate prompt restoration.
An elderly resident faced shock when approaching the minister in Velachery, and the office should ensure grievance procedures remain accessible.
Fibre boats arrived in Velachery for rain relief, and the office should track their deployment in waterlogged areas.
Heavy rain uprooted trees in over ten places across Chennai, and the office should coordinate clearance operations with municipal workers.
Velachery Main Road near the TANGEDCO substation was left unrepaired after cable work, and the office should direct authorities to restore the road surface.
A giant tree fell on a power line causing an eight-hour blackout in Thiruverkadu Shanmuga Nagar, and the office should monitor electricity board repair works.
Ponneri experienced a maximum rainfall of 11.9 cm, and the district team should track reservoir inflows and water levels.
Avadi cybercrime police arrested a Delhi man over a CEO fraud involving 1.90 crore rupees, and the office should review cyber security measures.
A US-based techie was arrested for using AI to send 1,500 hoax bomb threats across India, and the portfolio team should monitor investigative updates.
The MeitY Secretary stated that AI can improve disease screening and make healthcare affordable, and the office should review state digital health initiatives.
Chief Minister Vijay instructed in-charge ministers to return to Chennai immediately as monsoon rains intensify, and the office should ensure full compliance.
Chief Minister Vijay inspected flood relief operations on the ground as heavy rain battered Chennai, and the office should coordinate field responses.
Anbumani requested Chief Minister Vijay to notify Pallikaranai and make Chennai a Ramsar city, and the office should review wetland conservation proposals.
